{{Quote|Yes, I ''did'' sit down and talk surrender terms with Loathsom, over a cup of tarine tea. He became most ungentlemanly when he realized it was ''his'' surrender we were talking about. Have these people no manners? He didn't even offer me a sweet-sand cookie.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], talking afterwards about his surrender to [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]]|<ref name="CW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Sweet-sand cookies''' were a variety of [[Cookie/Legends|cookie]],<ref name="CW" /> that originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Calus]].<ref name="PSG" /> They were often served with [[Tarine tea/Legends|tarine tea]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] once recalled discussing surrender with [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]]. When the [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[General/Legends|general]] found out that it was, in fact, ''his'' surrender they were discussing; Kenobi says he became "most ungentlemanly" and didn't offer him a sweet-sand cookie.<ref name="CW" />
